name: Paimon
source:
An S-grade long range saboteur affiliated to <Gehenna> where Satan is king. Speaks in a chill way, is relaxed and carefree, but he is famous for leaving the battlefield particularly messy.

He likes bubble gum, and other devils sometimes curse him for being dirty when he blows bubbles and pops them all over his face.
